fresh_data.selection: one uniform retained non-hole tuple per episode; no backfill

limitations: Fresh evaluation is after prior development exploration
Signed residual is one-step TD, not Qpi error
Compatibility distance guard is not a support certificate
Frozen action screen does not establish trained-policy performance

mechanism_screen.scope: exploratory forced-action mechanism; no policy training or policy-efficacy claim

parity.scope: Exact direct/env state, reward, observation, time, termination and discount

runtime.deviation: CPU development diagnostic; frozen GPU study unchanged

source_receipt.omitted_side_effect: Upstream XLA_FLAGS assignment; worker sets the same value before imports
source_receipt.scope: Unmodified computational AST nodes; CLI, evaluation and data ingestion excluded
